name: packages
description:
Gestor universal de paquetes (winget, choco, scoop, npm, pnpm, pip, cargo, go, apt, dnf, pacman, brew, flatpak).
Acciones y argumentos (usar en args): add_repository { manager, url, name } | check_manager { manager } | info { manager, name } | install { manager, name } | install_package { manager, name } | list { manager } | list_installed { manager } | list_installed_packages { manager } | list_packages { manager } | list_repositories {} | package_info { manager, name } | remove { manager, name } | remove_package { manager, name } | remove_repository { manager, name } | search { manager, query } | search_package { manager, query } | uninstall { manager, name } | update { manager, name } | update_package { manager, name } | upgrade { manager, name }

action.description: Acción a ejecutar en el dominio packages
